Historical full-card image of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates) (Remastered 2006)|I Can't Believe He's Gone]], matching the [[Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.

== Source ==
* Package: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/holotable/windows/holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe] (Story #419).
* Distribution member: <code>cards/starwars/Virtual12-Light/large/icantbelievehesgone.gif</code>.
